subject: general
question: The new version of the Akash surface-to-air defence missile 'Akash 1S' is fitted with:

options.text: a new indigenously - developed command guidance programme

solution:
The correct answer is__** a new indigenously-developed seeker.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Akash 1S missile** is an upgraded version of the original Akash surface-to-air missile system developed by **DRDO** (Defence Research and Development Organisation) in India.
 
• The new seeker technology enhances the missile's **target acquisition** and **tracking capabilities**, making it more effective against various aerial threats.
 
• This missile can engage multiple targets simultaneously, providing an efficient air defense mechanism for the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The introduction of indigenous components reflects India's commitment to **self-reliance** in defense manufacturing, reducing dependency on foreign technologies.
 
• First test-fired in 2019 with successful trial results.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Missile Specifications**: The Akash missile system has a range of approximately **25 km** and can engage aerial targets at altitudes up to **18,000 meters**.
 
• **Command and Control**: It is equipped with a command and control system that allows it to operate effectively as part of a networked air defense system, providing real-time data to operators.
 
• **Previous Versions**: The earlier version, Akash 1, has been successfully deployed and used in various military exercises, proving its effectiveness as a surface-to-air missile system.
 
• **Future Developments**: Ongoing upgrades and improvements in missile technology, such as the **Akash 1S**, indicate a focus on enhancing India’s air defense capabilities in response to evolving threats.
